trends.name: Iran Uranium Seizure & Escalation
trends.summary: Trump administration is planning a covert military operation to seize ~1,000 lbs of highly enriched uranium from Iran, potentially requiring large troop airlift and weeks of operation. Iran's President responded with open letter to Americans, warning that attacks on vital infrastructure carry consequences extending beyond Iran's borders. This represents significant escalation in US-Iran tensions with major geopolitical and energy market implications.

trends.name: DHS Shutdown Resolution & Government Funding
trends.summary: GOP leaders Thune and Johnson announced joint plan to end the longest government shutdown in US history (Day 47) by advancing separate bills to fully fund DHS this year and next 3 years. Senate GOP intends to pass funding via unanimous consent Thursday morning pro forma session. This creates clarity on fiscal drag and TSA operations funding.

trends.name: Inflation Reacceleration via Tariffs & Geopolitics
trends.summary: ISM prices paid index surged to 78.3 in March (highest since 2022), up from 70.5 in February, driven by steel/aluminum tariffs and Middle East oil shocks. This signals entry into new persistent inflation regime with cost pressures feeding through supply chains. Directly threatens rate expectations and equity valuations.

trends.name: Strait of Hormuz Disruption & Yuan Payment Demands
trends.summary: Ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz are being asked to pay fees in yuan to obtain secret passcodes, signaling Iranian control measures and potential disruption to global shipping. Combined with US military strikes (12,300+ targets, 155+ vessels damaged), this threatens crude oil supply and forces currency diversification in energy trade.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Confidential Filing
trends.summary: SpaceX confidentially filed for IPO, setting stage for record offering. This is a major liquidity event in the aerospace/defense sector and signals investor appetite for space economy exposure amid increased military/government spending.

trends.name: Intel Buyback & Chip Sector Strength
trends.summary: Intel shares jumped 9% after buying back its Ireland chip fab, signaling renewed operational confidence. Combined with two chip stocks added to Deutsche Bank's top tech picks, this indicates semiconductor sector recovery and positive earnings momentum heading into earnings season.

trends.name: Small-Cap Rotation & Income Strategies
trends.summary: Small-cap rotation is gaining traction with focus on income vehicles like SCAP. This reflects portfolio reallocation from mega-cap tech into beaten-down value and income-generating assets, supported by falling recession odds (26% per Kalshi markets).

trends.name: Banking Sector Valuation Opportunities
trends.summary: Wells Fargo and Goldman Sachs highlighted as potential rally candidates with multiple strategies to ignite returns. Combined with Rithm Capital's 10% yield opportunity, this signals investor focus on beaten-down financials and high-yield positioning.

trends.name: Mortgage Market & Rate Volatility Impact
trends.summary: Whipsawing interest rates are threatening to chill the spring home-buying season, creating headwinds for housing demand and mortgage origination volumes. This impacts housing stocks and financial sector earnings.

trends.name: Crypto & Digital Assets Institutional Adoption
trends.summary: Franklin Templeton acquired digital assets investment firm, accelerating active crypto management and institutional legitimacy. Signals growing institutional adoption of digital assets amid macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Recession Odds Decline & Market Sentiment Shift
trends.summary: Recession odds dropped sharply to 26% from March highs, signaling improved economic expectations. However, this contrasts with warnings of a 'choppy, bumpy ride' in 2026, suggesting market uncertainty remains despite better near-term data.

trends.name: Pharmaceutical Pricing & Regulatory Headwinds
trends.summary: Eli Lilly CEO opposes Trump's drug pricing deals being passed into law, signaling pharma sector resistance to price controls. Creates regulatory uncertainty for big pharma earnings and valuations heading forward.
